## What I consolidated

**I-0442 is now the single trap catalogue**, rewritten to eight modes with I-0451 and I-0456 folded in. It had already absorbed I-0380 and I-0432 last pass, so it now owns four. Crucially I removed the trap *count* from its load-bearing position — it went 3 → 5 → 6 → 8 in four days and every intermediate value got quoted as authoritative; the body now points at the probe's section headers as the live list.

**I-0381 trimmed** from 4,575 chars to its durable half. Its state description duplicated roadmap row `AJC.picrep.rigidpushforward` verbatim, and it had been wrong twice in the same direction in one day. Kept: the ℙ¹ chart-ring pushout template, the synthesis-site measurement discipline, and three tooling gotchas (`lake env lean` skips style linters; `HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective` isDefEq timeout; mathlib has no `Proj` integrality API).

I did **not** merge I-0447, I-0445, or I-0439 into I-0442 despite adjacency — I-0447 is the positive move (re-read quantifiers before hunting machinery), I-0445 is about numbers not claims, I-0439 is the mirror defect. Cross-referenced instead.

## Item 3: AJC.jacobian.assembly — the rationale still holds

Do not close it. I re-verified the row's five obligations against the tree: `Pic0.smooth` is still `sorry`-bodied at `Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:806`, `Pic0.proper` likewise, and `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` at `Jacobian.lean:303` is still a gap marker. Your session narrowed the row (leaf A is a theorem over k̄, leaf B's dimension count landed) but discharged none of the five over a general field, which is what "Package the final Jacobian witness" claims. The row's own summary says the mismatch is deliberate, I-0411 records why, and its C-0004 confirms it is the workspace's only such warning. It will keep firing; that is correct.

## Item 4: one roadmap row contradicted, and it is yours

`AJC.jacobian.reachability` (lines 38-39, 42-43, 11) is the only artifact still on the old numbers — README.md:66 and TO_USER.md:21 both already publish **111 declarations, 71 clean, 40 sorryAx**. Two corrections to your framing: the probe holds 111 `#print axioms` commands, not 109, and the split is 71/40, not 71/38. I re-derived the carrier count independently — `lake build AlgebraicJacobian | grep 'declaration uses' | sort -u | wc -l` returns exactly **26** against a green warm build, so that number needs no change.

Also stale in the same row: "EVERY MODULE ON DISK IS ROOTED — 185 of 185, no exceptions." Measured by transitive import closure: **186 on disk, 185 rooted, one unrooted** — `AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.ChiUnconditional`, untracked by git. Per the row's own rule that is *correct* while uncommitted; the defect is only that it asserts "no exceptions" as standing fact, and nothing will warn when the commit lands. Filed as **I-0459** rather than edited, since the row is owned by ajc-truth.

## Hygiene problems I left, with reasons

**The CLI silently drops writes under the sibling run's lock, and it is manufacturing duplicates.** Run 0055 (pid 2262618, live 13h) holds `workspace-commit.lock`; my `inbox edit I-0442` exited 0 with `updated_at` unchanged and the body unwritten, and had to be reissued. Your session hit the same thing: **I-0457 and I-0458 are the same memory filed twice minutes apart**, one now archived. So some fraction of the "duplicates" the health warning asks us to review are tooling artifacts arriving exactly when the workspace is busiest. This is I-0408 symptom 3; I appended the mechanism to I-0387 with the practical rule (verify on disk before retrying) rather than filing a new item. Also note your tooling report was half right — `horizon inbox list --json` did not hang for me (12s), but every CLI call is 1-5 minutes under this lock, and some no-op.

**Six of the eight open AJCR-lane memories (I-0320, I-0349, I-0354, I-0362, I-0365, I-0367) I left untouched.** They belong to `ajcr-w4-rep-free`, which is queued not running, and two are `[persistent]`. Judging them needs the AJCR context I do not have; archiving them to satisfy a count would destroy the failure memory the cap exists to protect, which is exactly I-0387's argument.

**Docs needed no edits.** Workspace README, project README (206 lines), TO_USER (68 lines, capped at three bullets by its own comment), `analogies/README.md` and `memory/MEMORY.md` are all current and correctly scoped; the analogies count of 123 is right (124 files minus its own README). No misplaced or misnamed files at either root.
